wire.WireLong: JSON number only when -9007199254740991 < value < 9007199254740991; otherwise plain decimal JSON string
wire.Idempotency-Key: required non-blank String 1..128 for every command; same key+digest replays and different digest conflicts
wire.If-Match: required non-negative Integer equal to closure.version
wire.X-Task-Version: required non-negative Integer equal to cut_task.version

fields.preCheckNormal: Boolean|null in draft; required at submit
fields.executionNormal: Boolean|null in draft; required at submit
fields.testNormal: Boolean|null in draft; required at submit
fields.rollbackOccurred: Boolean|null in draft; required at submit
fields.rollbackReason: trimmed String 1..4000 iff rollbackOccurred=true, otherwise null
fields.finalResult: literal JSON null while saving DRAFT; SUCCESS|FAILED is supplied only by submit
fields.attachments: FileArtifactExpectation[] restricted to POST_COLLECTION_CHECKLIST|IMPLEMENTATION_COMMITMENT|OTHER_EVIDENCE, unique purposeCode+referenceKey, stable purposeCode then referenceKey; MANUAL_COLLECTION_RESULT is forbidden here and may only be created by linkManualResult

fields.resultRef: literal CUTOVER_CLOSURE:{closureId}:{submittedClosureVersion} only for submitted SUCCESS, otherwise null

fields.callbackEventId: non-blank String 1..128 for callback types, otherwise null
fields.resultRef: non-blank String 1..256 for callback types, otherwise null
fields.resultVersion: non-blank String 1..128 for callback types, otherwise null
fields.originalFailedCollectionTaskId: non-blank String 1..128 only for MANUAL_UPLOAD, otherwise null
fields.manualFile: FileArtifactExpectation with purpose MANUAL_COLLECTION_RESULT only for MANUAL_UPLOAD, otherwise null

fields.deviceId: positive WireLong in frozen task scope; one request creates exactly one collectionTaskId
positive WireLong in frozen task scope; one request creates exactly one collectionTaskId
fields.transientSecret: non-blank transient String accepted only for the synchronous INT-12 call and never persisted/logged/audited/returned
fields.saveAsCredential: Boolean; when true credential creation remains INT-12-owned

fields.deviceId: positive WireLong in frozen task scope

requestCollection.request: exactly SavedCredentialCollectionRequest or TransientCredentialCollectionRequest; existing DRAFT closure is required; transientSecret excluded from persistence, response and audit, while the digest includes authenticationMode, deviceId, stage, loginName, saveAsCredential and template identity
requestCollection.success: CommonResult<ClosureView> with one appended dispatch evidence and incremented closureVersion

linkManualResult.success: CommonResult<ClosureView> with appended manual evidence and incremented closureVersion

fields.finalResult: SUCCESS|FAILED, required and selected by the trusted engineer request

internalCollectionCallback.input: trusted tenant context, callbackEventId, collectionTaskId, deviceId, collectionStage, terminal outcome, resultRef/resultVersion, occurredAt, correlationId
internalCollectionCallback.idempotency: callbackEventId is claimed before CUT business locks; same payload replays without CUT row access, different payload conflicts; for a new event only DRAFT may append one terminal callback, while SUBMITTED/ARCHIVED returns permanent CLOSURE_ARCHIVED with zero CUT writes; never overwrites dispatch failure or earlier callback evidence
internalCollectionCallback.stateGuard: callback identity must match one DISPATCH_ACCEPTED row in the same DRAFT closure; submit requires every DISPATCH_ACCEPTED to have CALLBACK_SUCCEEDED or CALLBACK_FAILED, while DISPATCH_FAILED is already terminal
internalCollectionCallback.productionBoundary: INT-12 producer is external to this Feature; src/test callback driver may exercise the positive closure

allowedActionsRules.CREATE_CLOSURE: P6/CLOSURE_IN_PROGRESS, no closure, task owner, save permission and current ACTION_EDIT
allowedActionsRules.SAVE_CLOSURE: DRAFT, task owner, save permission and current ACTION_EDIT
allowedActionsRules.REQUEST_COLLECTION: existing DRAFT, matching closure/task versions, P6/CLOSURE_IN_PROGRESS with request permission, task owner and current ACTION_EDIT
allowedActionsRules.LINK_MANUAL_RESULT: DRAFT plus matching failed collection evidence, task owner and save permission
allowedActionsRules.SUBMIT_CLOSURE: complete DRAFT with required attachments, no DISPATCH_ACCEPTED lacking a terminal callback, task owner, submit permission and all source/file facts current

controlledSubstituteBoundary: ProjectScope, PLT and INT-12 may be deterministic src/test facts for CUT unit/integration/MySQL positive closure only; no production Bean, fallback or real-browser/Implementation Done claim
